slides.title: Small shop owners in November. The switch is official.

slides.title: Pumpkin display: out.

slides.body: "Wait, is our sales tax permit still current?": here.

slides.label: Switch 3

slides.body: "Who has the email about the insurance renewal?": on repeat.

slides.body: Fire extinguisher tags and the business license date: actually checked.

slides.label: Save this
slides.title: Switch now. Relax in December.
slides.body: Save this for next November, or for whoever runs the shop when you're on the floor.
